correctness.rationale: Independent reconstruction of the unitary integer Zak multiplier for g(t)=exp(-lambda t) on t>=0 and c exp(lambda t) on t<0 gives P/(1-rz)+Q/(z-r), P=e^{-lambda x}, Q=c r e^{lambda x}, r=e^{-lambda}. At z=-1 and 1 the reverse/ordinary triangle inequalities attain exact frequency extrema |P-Q|/(1+r) and (P+Q)/(1-r). Strictly decreasing P-Q and convex P+Q give the claimed optimal A,B and iff c<r or c>1/r. |Zg|² is real-analytic and nonconstant on connected cylinder, so its essential range is [A,B] with null level sets and no eigenvalues; elementary rational comparisons yield the unattained conditioning infimum. Independently sampled 293,020 Zak points for 4 lambda values and 7 amplitudes each and checked bounds/conditioning. Mesh is corroboration, not the universal proof.
